q: Do I need to book in advance?
a: We recommend booking ahead, especially for evenings and weekends, so we can reserve your room. You can book online on this website or call us on +84 395 546 979.
Mandala is open daily from 10:00 to 22:00. Please arrive a little early so you have enough time for your chosen treatment.

q: I’m not sure which treatment to choose – can you help?
a: Of course. Tell our reception how you feel (aches, poor sleep, skin concerns…) or add a note in the booking form, and we will recommend the right treatment free of charge.

q: Do you have rooms for couples or groups?
a: Yes. Mandala has private couple rooms, perfect for partners, friends and families. Please book ahead to reserve one.

q: Can I have a treatment while pregnant?
a: Some treatments are not suitable during pregnancy. Please let us know in advance so we can advise you, and check with your doctor.

q: Can I choose the massage pressure?
a: Yes. Your therapist will ask about your preferred pressure before you begin, and you can ask them to adjust it at any time.

q: Do you offer in-depth neck and shoulder therapy?
a: Yes. Besides our everyday neck and shoulder treatments, Mandala regularly hosts in-depth sessions with specialist therapists for chronic neck and shoulder pain. Follow our Facebook page or call us to find out about upcoming dates.

q: Are the red marks after gua sha or cupping normal?
a: Yes. The red marks come from tiny capillaries under the skin when it is scraped or cupped – a common reaction that usually fades within a few days. Please tell us beforehand if you have a bleeding disorder, take blood thinners or are pregnant.

q: How do I cancel or change my booking?
a: Please call us on +84 395 546 979 in advance and we will happily rearrange your appointment.

q: Do wellness treatments replace medical treatment?
a: No. Treatments at Mandala are for relaxation and general wellbeing and do not replace diagnosis or treatment by a doctor.
